name: Night sky
author: Brian Busch
description: Next sunrise/sunset, moon phase and moon-free dark hours in one pill; click for a sky chart (golden, blue, twilight, night; sun, moon and Milky Way core altitude) with cloud and aurora lanes.

barWidget.description: Sun event, moon glyph, dark hours and cloud/aurora flags; click for the night panel

schema.label: Latitude
schema.description: Decimal degrees, north positive. Leave empty to use the location set in Omarchy's weather panel.

schema.label: Aurora Kp
schema.description: Kp that flags an aurora chance. About 6 near 40-45° latitude, lower further poleward.

schema.label: Clouds and Kp
schema.description: Fetch hourly cloud cover (Open-Meteo) and planetary Kp (NOAA SWPC), at most once an hour.
